- The player is at rows 33-35, cols 20-23

The white bridge at rows 28-32, cols 20-23 is the connecting area that was previously dark gray. So SPACE converted the connecting area from dark gray to white!
This is progress! The connecting area (rows 28-31, cols 20-23) was dark gray, and now it's white. The top frame and left frame are still dark gray.
So the pattern seems to be:
1. Move the player to the position below the connecting area (cols 20-23)
2. Press SPACE to convert the connecting area to white
3. The top frame and left frame remain dark gray
Now I need to figure out how to convert the top frame and left frame to white (or blue).
Let me try SPACE again to see if the white bridge extends or if something else happens.
Actually, I notice the white bridge is at rows 28-32, which overlaps with the left frame's rows (28-31). But the left frame is at cols 16-19, and the white bridge is at cols 20-23. So they don't overlap.
Let me try SPACE again to see if the white bridge extends upward to cover the top frame.
